thesis: BTC ($82.7K) is 14.0% above its 20-week average and 13.6% above the 200-day, so the weekly trend reads up, and hl-cycles reads mild risk-on (allocation 66%, 2 of 6 stress conditions on: STH-SOPR below 1 and falling stablecoin supply). The Compass Macro lens is the weakest at 28 (Restrictive) and 10Y is 5.12%, so we lean that the range persists into the Oct 28 FOMC. Price sits 1.2% above the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) and 4.2% above the True Market Mean ($79.2K), with the Mean MVRV price ($105.7K) far overhead. Funding is near zero on BTC so leverage is not the driver; the bull case sees an up weekly trend and risk-on regime.
